relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: Zürcher was born in 1953, the only child of Sinologist Erik Zürcher (1928–2008).

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: Zürcher obtained a BA in Turkish studies from Leiden University in 1974.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: Three years later he received his MA in Turkish studies, with minors in both modern history and Persian.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: In 1984 he obtained his PhD in Turkish studies, also from Leiden University.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.role: assistant professor of Turkish and Persian
relations.evidence: From 1977 to 1989 Zürcher was an assistant professor of Turkish and Persian at the Radboud University Nijmegen.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: He subsequently was employed as associate professor of modern history at the same university until 1997.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: From 1990 to 1999 he was a senior researcher at the International Institute of Social History.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.role: affiliate professor of social history of the Middle East
relations.evidence: Between 1993 and 1997 Zürcher was an affiliate professor of social history of the Middle East at the University of Amsterdam.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: He is a professor of Turkish studies at Leiden University since 1997.

relations.subject: Erik-Jan Zürcher
relations.evidence: Zürcher was director of the International Institute of Social History between April 2008 and November 2012.
